_note: Phase 6 shop catalogue (prices are placeholders on the roadmap's scale: common 100-300, rare 400-700, epic 800-1,400, legendary 1,500-2,500). Cosmetic only. Items with rotating:true only show in the daily slots or the weekly bundle until owned; the rest are always listed. Camos are defined in mods/weapon-levels/camos.json (shop: <item id>) and outfits in mods/characters/characters.json (shop: <item id>). Music packs need the user's own music files, so none ship yet.
